entry.text: Financial Model of

projects.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
details: • Performed valuation of Mahindra & Mahindra using DCF and Multiples method for stock recommendation.
• Forecasted the financial line items based on assumptions from annual report and quarterly conference calls.
• Financial modelling involved collecting data from SIAM, TMA and industry reports by research agencies.
• Incorporated different scenarios based on expected industry growth rate for different product lines.
